summary: Successfully tested Admin Machines feature for adding/editing/deleting machines in vendor profiles. All 17 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend UI testing confirms Machines tab, Add Machine dialog, and form fields work correctly. Activity logging for create/update/delete operations verified.

issues: Dialog is well-designed with clear required field markers (*). Form validation works correctly for vendor_id and machine_category.

critical_code_review_comments: Activity logging implemented correctly for machine CRUD operations
RBAC permissions (machines.view, machines.create, machines.edit, machines.delete, machines.manage_images) properly enforced
Max 5 images limit per machine is enforced in the backend
data-testid='machines-tab-add-btn' is present on Add Machine button for testing
seed_data_creation: Test machines with prefix 'TEST_' created during testing are cleaned up automatically via pytest fixtures
